title: Usage-Based Pricing kickoff
text: Goal: launch metered per-event pricing. Usage events flow through kafka-events into billing-service. Ledger must support per-event writes, so this depends on Project Atlas (Postgres ledger-db). Decision: Usage-Based Pricing launches GA on Nov 15 behind a feature flag. Owners: Billing (meter consumer), Data (usage dashboard), Growth (pricing page).

title: Pricing Council - June
text: Annual plans have been abusing the 30-day full refund. Decision: monthly plans keep a 30-day full refund window; annual plans get prorated refunds instead of full refunds. Approved by Maya.

title: Atlas weekly sync
text: Cutover still on Oct 28. Rollback plan: keep dual-write on for 2 weeks after cutover. Risk: Tomasz is on parental leave from Nov 2, which is inside the rollback window, and he is the only one who has run the checksum verifier. Action: Omar to find a backup owner for ledger-db. No backup named yet.
